Readiness: can this instance reach the database right now? Used by
the frontend's "waking up the server" check and the deploy smoke test.
Reports only up/down - never connection details.

Proof that admin/student separation actually works end-to-end.

The real admin CMS (content CRUD, user overview, etc. - FR-ADMIN-*) is
not built yet; this route only exists to demonstrate and exercise the
require_admin gate so Phase 1's "student/admin separation proven" exit
criterion has something real to point at.

post.description:
Creates a draft test and its first draft version in one call.

A test is never content-less: every test has at least one
test_versions row from the moment it's created, since attempts and
future admin-authoring steps (sections/questions) always hang off a
version, not off the test row directly.

delete.description:
Drafts only - a published version can't be deleted (the DB trigger
rejects it too). Archive a published test instead.

post.description:
FR-ADMIN-08: creates a new draft test from a prepband-test/v1
document (the same shape as export and database/seeds/*.json). Audio
without a storage_key becomes a pending placeholder to upload later.

Hides a published test from the student catalog. Its version stays
published and immutable, so past attempts stay reproducible.

How a published test gets edited: copy it into a new draft, fix it,
publish the copy, archive the original.

owns those, not this table) and none of the more private profile
fields (target_band, exam_date, timezone) that don't belong in a
plain admin listing.

its own (the same rules as the single-test endpoints), so one test that

current order and ignores question_ids.

The student-safe content of the exact version this attempt was
started against - stays correct even if the test is republished or
archived while the attempt is open.

put.description:
Autosaved essay draft: one row per (attempt, task), overwritten on
every save, never duplicated. The server's word count is authoritative.

Records *metadata* about an answer - mode, duration, completion, or
the typed answer in text mode. The recording itself never reaches the
server (spec 3.8 recording storage policy).

The student's own rubric ratings. Allowed only after submission
(a DB trigger enforces the same) and always labelled self-assessment,
never a band score.

get.description:
The student's own attempts, newest first, filtered and paginated.
kind=full_mock keeps only module attempts taken inside a full mock.

Everything the progress charts need, from finished attempts only:
one point per attempt (oldest first), plus completion counts.

post.description:
FR-MOCK-01/04: starts a full mock, or returns the student's open one
(whatever its track) so a reconnect never creates a second.

schema.title: Response List Mocks Api V1 Mocks Get

post.description:
FR-MOCK-02/03/04: starts (or resumes) one module, in order, as an
exam-mode attempt against the version pinned for this mock. Calling it
again returns the same attempt - never a duplicate.

FR-MOCK-07: validates that all four modules are finished, then
completes the mock and issues its certificate. Idempotent.

Ends an unfinished mock so a new one can be started. Any module in
progress is cancelled (no score, no certificate).

get.description: FR-MOCK-05/06: consolidated, honest results for a completed mock.

schema.title: Response List Certificates Api V1 Certificates Get

patch.description:
FR-CERT-06: the holder opts in or out of public verification.
Nothing else about a certificate can be changed by its holder.

get.description:
FR-CERT-05/07: generated on demand from the server's own records and
streamed back; never stored, never built from client-supplied data.

FR-CERT-06: minimal public lookup - ID, validity, issue date. A
certificate whose holder hasn't opted in looks exactly like one that
doesn't exist, so codes can't be probed.

the shared prepband-avatars R2 bucket under
test-audio/<test_version_id>/... or test-images/<test_version_id>/...

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
Only the fields FR-AUTH-05 allows a student to change via this API.

email / avatar_url / onboarding_completed are deliberately excluded -
each already has its own authoritative write path (auth triggers, the
upload-avatar Edge Function, the onboarding flow) and must not become
overwritable through a generic profile PATCH.

later admin-authoring step, not part of this endpoint.
